name: Financial Assistance to Students who Cleared Civil Services Prelims Conducted by UPSC/APSC
benefit: - Financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The assistance is intended to support them in their preparation for the Mains Examination and succeed.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam and must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant must produce a valid Caste certificate which is duly certified/issued by the District Commissioner of the concerned district or his/her designated officer. - The applicant should have cleared the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission during the current year. - The applicant must produce his/her copy of the admit card and result of the Civil Services Preliminary Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission/Assam Public Service Commission. - The applicant should not be a Government service holder.
